summary_1line: After Sita enters the fire, the gods arrive and Brahma reveals that Rama is the divine Vishnu incarnate who came to slay Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita, calm and resolute, steps into the blazing sacrificial fire before a vast crowd of monkeys, warriors, and weeping women.
The sky fills with radiant chariots as Brahma, Shiva, Indra, and other gods descend above Lanka to address Rama.
Brahma stands before Rama and proclaims his divine nature as Vishnu while the assembled gods bow with folded hands.
